caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object resembling a decorative metal sconce or wall fixture. The object is rendered in brown tones, suggesting a metallic or bronze material. The central feature is a fluted, upward-opening cup or holder with a scalloped edge at the top, positioned inside an ornate wrought frame. The frame has an intricate, symmetrical design with curling motifs at the top and bottom, and two textured vertical panels on either side that appear to mimic a hatch or geometric pattern. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, with the object itself taking up the majority of the space and showing clear, detailed shading to indicate depth and texture. Handwritten text is faintly visible at the lower right of the image.
title: Match Holder
